message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. Noise violations are handled by the City’s Code Enforcement Division and the Atlanta Police Department. Here’s how you can do it:

| Method | How to File | Contact Info |
|--------|-------------|--------------|
| **Online** | Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website and use the “Report a Complaint” portal. Search for “Noise” or “Code Enforcement.” | https://www.atlantaga.gov/ |
| **Phone** | Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line at **404‑656‑4000** and ask to speak with the Code Enforcement or Public Safety Office. | 404‑656‑4000 |
| **In‑person** | Go to the City Hall or a local police precinct. Bring any evidence (photos, videos, timestamps) that supports your claim. | City Hall: 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303 |

### What to Include
- **Location** of the noise source (address or intersection).
- **Time and duration** of the disturbance.
- **Description** of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs).
- Any **documentation** (photos, videos, audio recordings, or witness statements).

### Follow‑up
After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. Keep it handy for any follow‑up calls or emails. The city will investigate and may issue citations or warnings depending on the severity and frequency of the violation.

If you’re unsure whether a particular activity violates city ordinances, you can also consult the City of Atlanta’s Code of Ordinances online or call the Code Enforcement office for clarification.
